name: AutomationBench
intro: AutomationBench 是 Zapier 的跨应用业务工作流 Agent 基准。当前官方仓库 1.0.6 提供六个业务域的 600 个公开计分任务，以及 200 个不计入正式分数的 simple 基线任务，覆盖 47 个模拟 SaaS 应用。Agent 根据单条指令发现并调用 API，评分检查最终业务状态；官方榜单使用独立且更难的私有留出集，不能直接等同本地公开集成绩。
build_method: 工作流形态聚类与领域选取，多模型合成和任务加固，独立提示模式可解性检查，抽样审计与奖励攻击反馈，版本化公平性修订
metric: task_completed_correctly：有效计分断言全部通过且分母大于零；partial_credit 为环境奖励；另报告每任务平均美元成本
task_type: Agent任务, 跨应用工作流, REST API工具调用
eval_feature: 单指令跨应用 API 探索与策略遵循，确定性终态断言，公开与私有成绩分离，simple 仅诊断，中断任务有限补跑
scale: 600 个公开计分任务（6 域各 100）+ 200 个 simple 基线；47 个应用；论文 v1 记载约 500 个端点与 600+ 私有任务，当前私有规模未由公开仓库核实
task_type_en: Agent Task, Cross-Application Workflow, REST API Tool Use
build_method_en: Workflow-shape clustering and domain selection, multi-model synthesis and hardening, separate hinted solvability checks, sample audits and reward-hacking feedback, versioned fairness revisions
eval_feature_en: Single-instruction cross-app API discovery and policy adherence, deterministic final-state assertions, separate public/private scores, diagnostic-only simple tasks, bounded aborted-task reruns
intro_en: AutomationBench is Zapier's benchmark for agents completing cross-application business workflows. Official repository version 1.0.6 provides 600 scored public tasks across six business domains and 200 simple baseline tasks excluded from the benchmark score, spanning 47 simulated SaaS apps. Agents discover and call APIs from a single instruction; grading checks final business state. The official leaderboard uses a separate, harder private holdout, so local public scores are not interchangeable with official results.
scale_en: 600 scored public tasks (100 per domain) + 200 simple baselines; 47 apps; paper v1 reports about 500 endpoints and 600+ private tasks; current private size is not independently verifiable from the public repository
metric_en: task_completed_correctly: all scored assertions pass with a nonzero denominator; partial_credit is the environment reward; mean USD cost per task is reported separately
